scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County seeks proposals for ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review. The work is described in Section A of Appendix D.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is an invitation by Rocky View County (the “County”) to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County’s ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
B. MANDATORY SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
B.1 
 Submission Form  
Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent.  
B.2  
Pricing  
Proponents are instructed to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission.  Instructions on how to complete the Pricing Schedule are set out in Appendix C of this RFP.  
B.3  Other Mandatory Submission Requirements 
Proponents are instructed to complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal. Proponents will be evaluated based on their responses to the criteria listed within the Mandatory Evaluation Table below. Any ‘No’ answers within the table will result in automatic disqualification unless the included justification satisfies the evaluation committee.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.

vendor_experience_required.value: Project Manager must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.
vendor_experience_required.quote:
(a) The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions.

(b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

value: Security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system, including role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.
data_security_requirements.quote: Security Protocols: Define the security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system. This encompasses role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.
